description:
Attempt 3 of the opus:F-09 legacy-row generalization (design docs/design/rule-record-runtime-statements.md §8 step 3). Parent/integration bead eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.4; prior attempts eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.4.1 and eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.4.2 — READ BOTH beads' descriptions and notes (including the SUPERVISOR REVIEW notes). The attempt-2 bead description (base spec + "ATTEMPT 2" section) still applies in full; this bead narrows and tightens it.

Worktree/branch: .worktrees/eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.4.3 on branch eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.4.3. It already contains attempt 2's commit 742651c5 cherry-picked onto the integration branch (== origin/main 7452fbff). Build on it; `npm ci` first.

## What is already accepted from attempt 2 (keep; don't churn)
Owner-module layout, row-specific R0 comments, the materializer (single definition, dual-channel projection, 175-key set), the tool-mention validator, the ledger/implemented changes (feats, customizing-a-background), all RULE_KNOWN_LIMITS entries (deferred ADR 0018 statements and partial limits), and the slice entries (cover, opportunity-attacks, charges, suffocating, channel-divinity — do not touch).

## What you must fix: the adjudication-context DM text
Supervisor review of 742651c5 found:
1. 63/110 RULE_ADJUDICATION_CONTEXT entries use the template "Retrieve <X> with lookup_rules, then apply its source direction to the scene: <the record's first source sentence>". Restating rules text is NOT Eshyra context: the source record is already beside the envelope in lookup_rules, and design R6 / invariant 4 separate Eshyra-authored annotation from rules text.
2. 83/110 list only lookup_rules; 31 of those refer to state work generically ("use the currency tools", "the encounter tools", "record the condition") instead of naming tools — e.g. rule:coinage dropped gain_currency/spend_currency/convert_currency. The tool-mention rule exists so the tool list matches the named tools; it is satisfied by naming the right tools, never by dropping them.
3. Spot-check tool correctness too: e.g. rule:falling uses `calc` for the 1d6-per-10-feet damage — dice are rolled with `roll` (or whatever DEFAULT_TOOLS actually provides for damage dice; read the tool descriptions in the orchestrator tool files).

Scope: EVERY RULE_ADJUDICATION_CONTEXT entry introduced by attempt 2 (not only the flagged ones) must meet the content standard below; rewrite those that don't. Enumerate with a script and record the before/after count of entries you changed.

## Content standard for each dmContext (what "Eshyra context" means)
A dmContext is Eshyra's statement to the DM about THIS rule at THIS table. Useful content is, in priority order:
- what Eshyra does NOT track or enforce for this rule, stated concretely (e.g. no grid, no movement budget, no light levels, no mount state, no tunnel/terrain state) — so the DM knows it must hold that in the narrative;
- which state Eshyra DOES hold that bears on the rule, and the exact tool(s) to read or change it (conditions → add_condition/remove_condition; HP → adjust_hp; currency → gain_currency/spend_currency/convert_currency; encounter/initiative → the actual encounter tool names; action economy → spend_turn_resource; checks/attacks/saves → resolve_check; etc. — verify every name against DEFAULT_TOOLS and read each tool's description to use it correctly);
- the specific judgment the rule leaves to the DM, if the source leaves one.
Do NOT paraphrase or quote the rule's own text; do not tell the DM to "retrieve" or "consult" the rule (it is already reading it). 1–3 sentences. If Eshyra holds no relevant state and the rule needs no tool, a short concrete statement of what Eshyra leaves to the DM is correct (e.g. "Eshyra does not track burrowing movement or the tunnels it leaves; the DM holds both in the narrative.") — tools then legitimately = ['lookup_rules'].

## Mechanical checks you must add (permanent — they are this channel's contract)
In validateRuleAdjudicationContext (or a validator beside it, used by tests):
- reject a dmContext that refers to tools generically: a phrase like "the <word> tools", "the <word> tool" not followed/preceded by an exact registered tool name, "currency tools", "encounter tools", "usage tools" (design your pattern so the three slice entries pass; charges currently says "the usage tools" — if it trips the check, STOP and record it on this bead rather than editing approved slice text, and exclude nothing silently);
- reject dmContext containing "source direction", "Retrieve ", or "consult".
In a test (permanent; it protects design invariant 4 — Eshyra annotation is not rules text): for every RULE_ADJUDICATION_CONTEXT and RULE_KNOWN_LIMITS entry, no run of 8 or more consecutive words of the dmContext/statement (case-insensitive, punctuation-normalized) appears in the record's source text in the committed pack. Measure its runtime first; keep it only if it runs in well under a second.
Keep the attempt-2 sentence-collision probe as a one-off script run (not a test) and paste its clean output in your notes.

## Completion report (bd update --append-notes)
Count of entries rewritten; 10 before/after examples spanning different chapters; the checks' outputs; tool corrections made (like falling); final R0 tally recomputed by script. Then verify:worktree, commit, close.

Disjointness constraint from the base spec still applies (no importer/pack/relationship/design files). Condition-relationships work is in PR #595; don't touch it.
